title: Code, trained agents and processed results for: Certificate-Enforcing Adaptive Disturbance-Observer Sliding-Mode Control for Battery-Supercapacitor Electric Vehicles and a Held-Out Benchmark of Learned and Model-Predictive Supervisors
description:
Reproducibility package for a two-tier controller of a battery-supercapacitor hybrid energy storage system (HESS) in an electric vehicle: a certificate-enforcing adaptive disturbance-observer sliding-mode controller (tier 1) and a safety-filtered TD3 reinforcement-learning supervisor (tier 2).

Contents: Python simulator and NumPy TD3 implementation (MIT), trained actor networks, processed result files, tables and figures (CC BY 4.0), and scripts that regenerate every table and figure of the manuscript. The 1 Hz drive-cycle speed profiles in data/cycles/ are third-party data copied from the NREL FASTSim repository (pinned commit 63808be8) and keep their own terms; see DATA_LICENSE.md.

Not included: the raw per-run simulation logs (about 0.4 GB), which are regenerated by scripts/evaluate.py.
